_doc: Object-level verification cases for the migrated HR sample schema (corpus/mariadb/hr).
Same format as cases.json; 'corpus' and 'load' tell verify_objects.py which files to load for every case.
Expected values are what Oracle returns for the same input (corpus/oracle/hr). Error numbers are MariaDB's; the Oracle error is in the case name.
SECURE_DML reads SYSDATE, which SET timestamp does not move in MariaDB, so its predicate is checked on fixed timestamps instead of by calling it.
